Shipping and returns

Orders ship within two business days from Portland. Shipping is free on orders over 150 USD within the United States, and we ship to Canada and the EU at cost.

Returns are accepted within 60 days, worn or unworn. Gear should be tried properly before you commit to it, and you cannot tell whether a shell works by standing in a shop. If you have used something hard and it failed, tell us what happened — that is more useful to us than an unworn return.

Repairs are free for the first three years on everything we make.
